title: Sev1 Customer Comms Playbook — prep + action log
content:
Quick notes and prep for a fast-moving Sev1 escalation — personal scratchpad for the 1:1 sync before the customer war-room. Goal: ensure comms are consistent, owners aligned, and actions are tracked in a way we can hand to CS/AE for customer-facing updates.

Context:
- Customer: BrightAcres (production ML infra for recommendation engine).
- Trigger: sudden 15–40% increase in tail latency for /generate endpoint; elevated error rate in region us-west-2.
- Recent change: rolling config tweak of batching/autoscaler 2025-11-03 (ticket CFG-1284).
- Impact: Some customers in the tier-experienced latency regressions; BrightAcres reports sustained errors affecting A/B test traffic.

Meeting objective (prep 1:1 with Marcus):
1) Align immediate containment steps and who speaks to BrightAcres.
2) Finalize timeline and ETA messaging for war-room kickoff.
3) Lock initial action owners and escalate to SRE if infra rollback required.

Pre-kickoff checklist (things I want to confirm in 1:1):
- Have we paused the autoscaler window for us-west-2? (Marcus to confirm)
- Is there a safe rollback candidate for the batching tweak? (Nina to check recent deploys)
- Can we get an experimental key to throttle A/B traffic for BrightAcres? (Saeed owns rate-limit knob)
- Chat ops channel created: #cust-4821-thread (done)

Agenda for war-room (30–45m):
- 0–5m: Quick context + Triage lead (who will run the play)
- 5–15m: Data snapshot: latency percentiles, error types, recent deploys, traffic routing
- 15–25m: Containment options and immediate actions (flag toggles, throttles, rollback, routing)
- 25–35m: Comms plan & cadence (who messages customer, draft message, frequency)
- 35–45m: Action log owner assignment + ETA & follow-ups; decision to escalate to infra

Scripted customer comms (three short templates) — short, clear, timestamped:
1) Acknowledgement (send within 15m):
   "We’re aware of elevated errors/latency for your account in us-west-2. Our engineering team is investigating and will provide an update in 30 minutes. We prioritize your traffic and will share mitigation steps as soon as we have them."
2) Status update (every 30–60m):
   "Update: root cause investigation underway. Current actions: pausing autoscaler window, evaluating batching rollback. No data loss observed. Next update in 45 minutes or on change."
3) Resolution/Next steps:
   "Issue mitigated by rolling back batching config and re-routing a small portion of traffic. We are monitoring and will perform a full post-incident report with timeline and RCA within 48 hours. Action items include rollback validation and runbook improvements."

Playbook decision tree (quick mental model):
- If errors < 5% drop in 15m after toggle -> continue monitoring, schedule gradual rollback if regression persists.
- If errors remain high or increase -> immediate rollback + route to dedicated pool; inform customer of measured ETA (1–2 hours).
- If regression is tied to infra (OOM, kernel issues) -> escalate to SRE lead, activate infra rollback plan.

Risk checklist (what to avoid in comms):
- Don’t promise exact ETA unless we have a verified mitigation path.
- Avoid technical noise in customer-facing messages (keep it outcome-focused).
- Don’t switch owners mid-message — single point of contact for BrightAcres during active incident.

Action registry (initial items I want on the war-room board — simple, assignable):
- ACT-01: Pause autoscaler aggressiveness in us-west-2 (owner: Marcus Lee) — status: requested; estimated 10m to take effect.
- ACT-02: Validate safe rollback artifact for batching change (owner: Nina Gomez) — status: investigating; feedback by +30m.
- ACT-03: Open temporary rate-limit for BrightAcres A/B users (owner: Saeed Khan) — status: queued; need QA sign-off.
- ACT-04: Draft and approve customer acknowledgement (owner: Elena Park) — status: ready; send after 1:1.
- ACT-05: Start metric guardrails to measure recovery (owner: Marcus Lee) — status: pending; dashboards: latency-p50/p95/p99, error-rate, 5m rolling.

Decision points to capture during war-room (so we have clean handoff):
- DECIDE-1: Rollback now vs wait for toggle impact (criteria: error change within 15m and p99 latency trend).
- DECIDE-2: Assign single POC for customer (default: Elena Park unless the AE requests their CS lead).
- DECIDE-3: Need for SRE escalation (criteria: infra metrics show host-level failures or sustained error > 20%).

Notes to self (questions for Marcus in 1:1):
- If we rollback, what is the fastest safe window to revert without triggering cache thrash?
- Any recent infra noise in us-west-2 (network maintenance, host churn) that could confound rollback signals?
- Do we have capability to move BrightAcres traffic to a different region temporarily (regulatory/customer consent needed)?

Handoff checklist (post-war-room):
- Export action registry to JIRA (one ticket per action, link back to INC-4821).
- Post update to #cust-4821-thread and tag AE + CS lead.
- Create short digest for BrightAcres with timeline and next ETA (send via AE).
- Schedule 15m follow-up sync in 2 hours and 1:1 RCA debrief in 48 hours.

Post-meeting quick template (to paste in Slack after war-room ends):
"Summary: BrightAcres affected by increased latency/errors in us-west-2. Actions: paused autoscaler (Marcus), validating rollback (Nina), applied rate-limits (Saeed). Customer ack sent; monitoring. Next update in 45m. Action board: <link to INC-4821>"

Open questions / follow-ups I still need to research before the war-room:
- Confirm exact deploy IDs impacted (compare rollout list from Nov 2–4).
- Check whether any canary traffic was inadvertently routed back to prod variant.
- Make sure rollback unit tests exist for the config change (so we can signal safe rollback).

Personal reminders: bring a short decision script to the war-room (three options only) so we force choices and avoid indefinite fiddling. Keep comms conservative and timestamped.

---
Last edits log: 2026-02-20 — updated templates and action owners after runbook review.

(End of scratchpad — convert to proper war-room agenda and upload to INC-4821 before kickoff.)
